Title: Q Agaitas the scolar of antiquites

Messages.Author: garou
Messages.Body:
Card text says : " Whenever you play a card, you may draw its replacement
from your prey's library instead of your own. Put the card drawn face-up in
front of you. It is still considered to be in your hand, and be played or
discarded as normal."

The card reafears when the Vampire plays a card or when the Mathuselah when
this vamp is ready?
For exemple: when I play a master card or some other card , that doesn't
involve the vamp but i have him into play , what happens?
or when this vamp plays a some card for itself for exp: auspex intercept?

> For exemple: when I play a master card or some other card , that doesn't
> involve the vamp but i have him into play , what happens?

You can use his special.

> or when this vamp plays a some card for itself for exp: auspex intercept?

You can use his special.
